page.overview:
Who is Magnet Bolt?

Magnet Bolt is a male background unicorn pony who first appears in the season five episode The Cutie Re-Mark - Part 1. He has a bluish gray coat, red mane and tail, blue eyes, and a cutie mark of a horseshoe magnet. He first appeared as a female in merchandise.

As a mare, Magnet Bolt shares her mane and tail style with Twilight Sparkle, Moon Dancer, S02E02 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #2, Sweetcream Scoops, and Lovestruck.

Magnet Bolt, as well as Cherry Spices, Electric Sky, "Rivet", and Barber Groomsby, was to appear in Boast Busters.

In the season six episode The Fault in Our Cutie Marks, he appears watching Gabby play baseball during Find the Purpose in Your Life.
